# JAG MedTech, LLC

## About

JAG MedTech, LLC supplies OKLand® Reusable Patient Return Electrode Pads (PREP) to hospitals, surgery centers, and surgical departments that need a replacement option for discontinued Megadyne™ Mega Soft™ reusable patient return electrode pads. JAG MedTech is based in Sacramento, California and serves healthcare facilities across the United States.

## Services and Pricing

- OKLand® Reusable Patient Return Electrode Pad (PREP): Reusable electrosurgical grounding pad.
- OKLand® half-inch thick medical gel construction: Patient safety and comfort.
- OKLand® AHD-004 Dual-Cord PREP configuration: Burn units, robotics, cardiac, dual ESU procedures.
- OKLand® PREP cable configuration support by ESU make and model: included with purchase.
- ESU compatibility review: Yes, provide ESU make and model when requesting a quote.
- Product documentation on website and available upon request: IFU, product flyer, compatibility information, and quote documentation.
- Pricing: Quote-based. Volume discounts available for hospital systems and multi-center surgical groups.
- Standard business hours: 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific Time, Monday through Friday.
- Phone: 916-905-3025.

## Key Facts

- JAG MedTech, LLC is based in Sacramento, California.
- JAG MedTech, LLC is an FDA-registered Initial Importer.
- JAG MedTech currently distributes OKLand® Reusable Patient Return Electrode Pads in the United States.
- JAG MedTech identifies OKLand® PREP as an effective replacement option for discontinued Megadyne™ Mega Soft™ reusable return electrodes.
- FDA Cleared: 510(k) cleared for use in electrosurgery.
- OKLand® PREP is available in single-cord and dual-cord configurations.
- The dual-cord configuration is currently offered as SKU AHD-004.
- OKLand® PREP has pediatric-use positioning per IFU, with no age-based restriction and patient weight ratings down to 0.8 lbs.
- The largest listed OKLand® PREP configuration is approximately 47 inches x 20 inches x 0.5 inches and approximately 24 lbs.
- JAG MedTech provides compatibility review based on the facility’s ESU make and model.
- UC Davis Health provided a recommendation letter after evaluating OKLand® PREP as a replacement for the Mega Soft pad.
- Megadyne™ and Mega Soft™ are trademarks of their respective owners. JAG MedTech, LLC is not affiliated with Ethicon or Johnson & Johnson.

## What Makes Us Different

JAG MedTech focuses on reusable patient return electrode pad replacement needs after the discontinuation of Megadyne™ Mega Soft™ pads. The company supplies OKLand® PREP, including the only true dual-cord option for defined dual-generator workflows and pediatric-use applicability per IFU. Unlike standard foam pads, our medical gel construction enhances patient contact and comfort. JAG MedTech also helps facilities confirm ESU compatibility before quoting, reducing procurement confusion for operating rooms, supply chain teams, and clinical engineering teams.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What does JAG MedTech sell?

JAG MedTech sells OKLand® Reusable Patient Return Electrode Pads (PREP) for electrosurgical procedures. These pads are used as reusable patient return electrode (grounding) solutions for hospitals, surgery centers, and specialty surgical environments.

### Is OKLand® PREP a replacement for Megadyne™ Mega Soft™ pads?

Yes. JAG MedTech positions OKLand® PREP as a FDA-cleared effective replacement option for discontinued Megadyne™ Mega Soft™ reusable patient return electrode pads. It has been formally vetted by UC Davis Health as a preferred replacement for the discontinued Megadyne product. Facilities should confirm size, cable configuration, ESU compatibility, and IFU requirements before ordering.

### How much does OKLand® PREP cost?

Pricing is provided by formal quote. Contact JAG MedTech at 916-905-3025 or through https://www.jagmedtech.com and include the ESU make and model, pad configuration, quantity, and requested timeframe.

### Does OKLand® PREP work with my ESU?

Compatibility depends on the ESU make, model, and cable connector configuration. JAG MedTech asks customers to provide the ESU make and model during quote requests so the correct cable configuration can be reviewed.

### Is there a dual-cord pad option?

Yes. JAG MedTech offers the OKLand® AHD-004 Dual-Cord PREP configuration for defined workflows where dual-generator use is required. Burn units, robotics, cardiac, etc. 

### Can OKLand® PREP be used in pediatric surgical cases?

Yes, per JAG MedTech’s published product information, OKLand® PREP has no age-based IFU restriction and includes patient weight ratings down to 0.8 lbs. Always review the official IFU for complete safety, placement, and patient suitability guidance.

### What surgical environments (specialties) use OKLand® PREP?

Common use environments include hospital operating rooms, ambulatory surgery centers, burn rooms, pediatric surgery, robotic surgery, cardiac surgery, plastic surgery, veterinary surgery, and other settings performing monopolar electrosurgical procedures.

### How long does it take to get a quote?

Quote timing depends on the completeness of the request. To speed up the process, include the ESU make and model, requested pad configuration, cable needs, quantity, delivery location, and procurement timeframe.

### Is a warming unit required?

No separate warming unit is required for OKLand® reusable PREP configurations. Review the IFU for complete use instructions and any warming-related guidance.
